## Reading (ASSERTED, from the table above and the database)

- **Mar 2022 to Dec 2024: carry at zero.** The only excursion (May to Aug 2023: overpayment 23445 against later short-paid invoices 22252 and 23258, settled by 23395) closed back to zero.
- **30 Dec 2024: carry turns negative, R-1,258.64.** Payment 35877 (R9,649.56) exceeds the gas part of invoice 39311 (R8,390.92) by R1,258.64. The database records 35877 at R8,390.92, which suggests the excess was not allocated to any invoice (not confirmed in the ERP).
- **Jan to Jul 2025: swings net back to about R-1,258.7.** Extra payments 36509, 36512 (31 Jan) and 38270 (15 Apr) are absorbed by gas invoices that received no same-amount payment (41238, 41562, 42614, 42875, and 43287 short-paid by 6,446.60).
- **18 Aug 2025: R-6,037.50 more.** Payment 40757 (R7,400.19) paid all of invoice 45528, including its R6,037.50 cylinder deposit lines, which stay owed in Part 1B.
- **17 Dec 2025: R-517.50 more.** Payment 42636 (R517.50, database reference 44730) pays the 9kg deposit that credit note 12956 left uncredited in Jul 2025, which also stays owed in Part 1B.
- **11 Feb 2026: R+6,960.00.** Rental invoice 49204 is unpaid, giving the -853.7 carry seen on the 2026 statements.
- **Net position.** The two deposit payments (R6,555.00) mirror R6,555.00 of the R7,406.00 Part 1B balance. What is left is the Dec 2024 overpayment (R1,258.64) less the R851.00 deposit balance carried in Part 1B since Aug 2023: about R407.6 in the customer's favour.
